name: Sichuan Development Lomon Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Development Lomon Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of phosphorus chemical products in China. The company offers phosphorus chemical products, including industrial-grade monoammonium phosphate, fertilizer-grade monoammonium phosphate, feed-grade dicalcium phosphate, and various compound fertilizers as well as lithium iron phosphate.
